skill.summary: TopMediai text-to-speech skill. Supports key entitlement info, voices listing (official + cloned), and text-to-speech generation.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of tts-topmediai.

- Provides text-to-speech conversion with official and cloned voices.
- Includes commands to check API key entitlement and list available voices.
- Requires API key configuration before use.
